## HEAD

**Operator-voice anchor** (Joe, 2026-09-26, `*claude-repl:claude-14*`, verbatim):

> Right, well speaking of 象, I had been discussing a 象-2000 implementation of
> McCarthy's Elephant-2000 ideas, and the xlate stuff that feeds into feed.html
> would be a great data source.  The result of being able to rewind to a given
> place in a development cycle etc. (e.g. to right before red tape started) and
> debug how it came to be would be very cool.

**Provenance:** operator turn in the claude-14 REPL, 2026-09-26 ~02:50 UTC,
following a discussion of the @why graph and the pattern-mining run. Earlier
象-2000 discussion: the 象/ pattern family (futon3 `10643d9`, `b871428`),
seeded from turn-Ogz2uU (2026-09-23): "we have XTDB, so we have an as-of
database; this is basically the infrastructure needed to build Elephant 2000".

**HEAD exit: Met.**
The operator's anchor turn is recorded verbatim above.
